import csv

def render_row(fields, record, missing="-"):
    def escape_field(field):
        field = field.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        field = field.replace("\t", "\\t")
        field = field.replace("\n", "\\n")
        return field

    escaped_fields = [escape_field(field) for field in fields]
    escaped_record = [escape_field(field) if field is not None else missing for field in record]
    return "\t".join(escaped_record)

# Example usage:
fields = ["name", "age", "city"]
record = ["Alice", None, "Wonderland"]
print(render_row(fields, record))
